remarks: Introducing “Southpoint Haven, ” a charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath home nestled within the gated Southpoint Estates community in Orcutt, where inviting interiors, thoughtful details, and comfortable Central Coast living come together. Thoughtfully arranged for everyday living, this home offers a welcoming layout with character throughout, including an upstairs loft that provides additional flexible living space. Inside, the living room creates a warm gathering space with a cozy fireplace, subtle archway details, and a front-facing bay window that fills the room with natural light.
